prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Sugar Land, Texas. Injury: concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1193; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was making a left turn at an intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car as it came through the crossing traffic. The impact pushed my car sideways and my head hit the window frame hard enough that I lost my focus for a few moments. When the paramedics arrived, I was dizzy, had a headache, and was having trouble keeping my thoughts in order, and I was later diagnosed with a concussion. I have described what happened the same way every time I have spoken about it, whether to the officer at the scene, to the medical staff, or to my insurer. I am the named driver on this policy and I was operating the vehicle with the owner's permission at the time. I am requesting coverage for my medical treatment, time away from work, and repairs to my vehicle.
